{"choices": [{"finish_reason": "tool_calls", "index": 0, "message": {"content": "Now I have a clear understanding of the bug. Let me trace through the issue:

In `start_watchers`, when `Fluent::FileWrapper.stat(target_info.path)` raises `Errno::ENOENT`, it calls:
```ruby
stop_watchers(target_info, immediate: true, unwatched: true)
```

Here `target_info` is a single `TargetInfo` Struct object, but `stop_watchers` expects a hash and calls `targets_info.each_value`. A `TargetInfo` Struct doesn't have `each_value`, hence the `NoMethodError`.

Let me write a reproduction script to confirm the error.", "role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [{"function": {"arguments": "{"command":"cd /testbed && cat > /tmp/reproduce.rb << 'EOF'\nrequire 'fluent/plugin/in_tail'\n\ntarget_info = Fluent::Plugin::TailInput::TargetInfo.new(\"/tmp/nonexistent_file\", 12345)\n\n# Simulate the stop_watchers call with a single TargetInfo object\nbegin\n  target_info.each_value { |ti| puts ti }\nrescue NoMethodError => e\n  puts \"Reproduced error: #{e.message}\"\nend\nEOF\nruby /tmp/reproduce.rb"}", "name": "bash"}, "id": "call_-7355837277785816113", "index": 0, "type": "function"}]}}], "created": 1700000028, "id": "synthesized-00028", "model": "glm-5.2", "object": "chat.completion", "request_id": "synthesized-00028", "usage": {"completion_tokens": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 0}}
